On a remote island, a group of players will compete for victory in a reality competition and strategy show governed by Plex's rules.


Netflix has announced the start of production on


Plex: Última partida


, a competitive strategy reality show in which a group of renowned players arrive on a remote island at Plex’s invitation, where they will compete for victory and a substantial cash prize.


Plex


, one of the most prominent content creators today, joins Netflix as the


game master


of


Plex: Última partida


, a collaboration in which he will set the rules and determine the players’ fate.


Produced by


Fremantle


,


Plex: Última partida


will be filmed across several islands in the Dominican Republic and will arrive on Netflix soon.


About Fremantle:


Fremantle is one of the world’s leading global creators, producers and distributors of content. With a presence in 28 territories, it creates and brings local stories to audiences around the world across entertainment formats, series, films and documentaries, including internationally successful titles such as


Love Never Lies


,

,
